items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: that fellow that played there with me, his name was Neil Grasshofer

ctx.x: I see. And violin, of course, was a very important instrument, I think, earlier in jazz.

Violin fit in pretty good, yeah. I believe it or not, that fellow that played there with me, his name was Neil Grasshofer. I haven't seen that fellow since I played, and that was in 19, about 1923, 24. And I haven't seen him since.
